caseStudy.title: Masse
caseStudy.lead: Online booking for a billiard club: guests reserve a pool table or a dartboard for a free slot, while an admin panel manages the data and the evening's reservations.

facts.label: Client
facts.value: Masse, a billiard club in Užice, Serbia

brief.title: The brief
text: The club wanted guests to see free slots and book a pool table or a dartboard themselves, and staff to manage the bookings in one place.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the native Android app in Java on Firebase Auth, Firestore, Storage, Messaging and Analytics.
Showed six pool tables and four dartboards, each with its own booking screen.
Built booking by name, phone, date and slot from 17:00 to 02:00, with taken slots marked.
Added My reservations and a rule that a booking lapses after 15 minutes of lateness.
Built the web admin panel to manage the data, see the reservations and delete them.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: Guests book their own table or dartboard, and the club manages the evening from the admin panel.
